nodes.question: Which rivers are included in the micro-basins mentioned in the case study?
nodes.answer: The micro-basins mentioned in the case study include the Guasuntos, Picay, and Chanchan rivers.
nodes.paragraph: Therefore, the predominant aim of the current study has been to understand the Natural Hazards triggers that generate the problem of generation of this catastrophic event, thus trying to establish the main characteristics of the macroslide, such as identifying the geological and geotechnical conditions from geophysical studies of the study area. Finally, we intend to determine the possible triggers, by analyzing the instability of the slopes in the vicinity of the study area. 2 Description of the study area Due to the geodynamic constellation, the continental part of Ecuador based on the Car - ibbean and South american continental plates, is subducted by the oceanic Nazca Plate, which process generates a variety of volcanic and mountainous landscapes known as the Andes (Cobos-Mora et al. 2023; Mora et al. 2022). The study area is located in the Chunchi canton of the Chimborazo province, situated on the eastern foothills of the western Cordil- lera of the Andean mountain range (Fig. 1).
